title: Pure Super Quant
summary: Super Quant cards only, with generic staples. Each Super Quantum Layer has a matching Mech Beast Xyz Monster, which gets its Quick Effect when that Layer is attached as material, and three different Mech Beasts make Super Quantal Mech King Great Magnus through Super Quantal Mech Ship Magnacarrier. The 2025 DARK pair leads. Super Quantal Fairy Zetan summons itself next to a Super Quant, then tributes itself to summon any Super Quant monster from the Deck. Super Quantum Black Layer summons itself when the opponent activates a monster effect, turns straight into a Mech Beast and searches a Super Quant Spell when it goes to the GY. Layer 19 is not out in the TCG yet.

main: Super Quantal Fairy Zetan

Super Quantum Black Layer
Newest card: summons itself on their monster effect and becomes a Mech Beast; searches a Spell from the GY.
Super Quantum Blue Layer
Starter: searches any Super Quant card when summoned.
Super Quantum Red Layer

Super Quantum Green Layer

Super Quantal Fairy Alphan
